Stack: Hummingbird 2.26 + Elementary 0.8.1 + hummingbird-elementary 0.5.1.
Language mode: Swift 6. Tools version: 6.4.

```sh

If a 6.4 toolchain is unavailable, open `preview/index.html`.

Routes: `/` `/wdbx` `/abi` `/abbey` `/platform` `/architecture` `/company` `/investors` `/research` `/services` `/contact`.

```
